items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Biscuit they call him too. Tats Biscuit.

ctx.x: Yeah, well Tats. He's got another nickname which I forgot. I wrote it down. He's got a name. Biscuit they call him too. Tats Biscuit. Probably so. And that's Kid Thomas' piano player, Joe James. See the skull? That's Larry's. See the skull.
What a face on this one.
